title: TypeSafe judge models in make_judge(): only bool and finite Literal outputs via typesafe:/ URIs
answers: Why does my make_judge() TypeSafe judge reject feedback_value_type=str or int?
How do I get a categorical label out of a TypeSafe judge, and what values are allowed in the Literal?
Where is the TypeSafe probability or confidence stored on the assessment?
Can I use a TypeSafe judge with a {{ trace }} template or with inference_params or base_url?
body:
Path: `make_judge(model="typesafe:/<model-id>")` and built-in judges that accept a `model` argument (e.g. `is_correct`) send one TypeSafe System One question per judge through the TypeSafe judge client in `mlflow/genai/judges/typesafe.py`, with HTTP going through `_get_http_response_with_retries`. Covers bool yes/no decisions and categorical Literal labels, and writes TypeSafe probability data into assessment metadata.
Rule: `feedback_value_type` must be `bool` (sent as a Noul question; True when `typesafe.probability >= 0.5`) or a finite `Literal[...]` (sent as a Choice question). Literal values must be JSON string, number or boolean scalars with distinct string forms, 1 to 255 values. Metadata keys: `typesafe.model`, `typesafe.probability` (bool), `typesafe.probabilities` and `typesafe.confidence` (Literal), optional `typesafe.legend`; no rationale text. TypeSafe has no abstention, so represent uncertainty as an explicit literal such as "unknown".
Constraints: Applies only to `typesafe:/` URIs. Unsupported: unconstrained str/int/float/object/container outputs, Score questions, `{{ trace }}`, multi-question judges, and `inference_params`, `base_url`, `extra_headers`. Use a versioned ID such as `typesafe:/jev-1.13.0` when results must be reproducible; `jev-latest` floats. Direct calls need a local `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`. Does not apply to `gateway:/` models.
applies: Applies to MLflow GenAI judges (make_judge and built-in judges) configured with a typesafe:/ model URI.
says: Custom evaluation judge crashes when configured for freeform text or numeric score output.
Allow the model evaluation judge to classify outputs into a fixed list of categories.
The automated judge assessment displays probability scores but never includes an explanation or reasoning.
Add an explicit unknown label option for uncertain ratings in the evaluation scoring rubric.
Model evaluator setup rejects custom connection endpoints and full execution trace templates.
search: MLflow GenAI judges configured with typesafe:/ URIs restrict feedback_value_type to bool or finite Literal outputs with 1 to 255 scalar values. The TypeSafe judge client in mlflow/genai/judges/typesafe.py evaluates one question per judge and records typesafe.model, typesafe.probability, or typesafe.probabilities and typesafe.confidence in assessment metadata without rationale text. The typesafe:/ integration does not support unconstrained str, int, float, container types, Score questions, {{ trace }}, multi-question judges, inference_params, base_url, or extra_headers. Direct calls require TYPESAFE_API_KEY, versioned model IDs ensure reproducible results, and gateway:/ models are not covered.
